follow-up time: Not specified, but described as the 'follow-up period'
outcome: Rate of intensive care unit admission
cohort: 14 pediatric patients with rare syndromes and recurrent infections
finding: Immunoglobulin replacement therapy (IGRT) in pediatric patients with rare syndromes and recurrent infections was associated with improved immunological function and reduced rates of infections, hospitalizations, and intensive care unit admissions.
mod_finding: The study mentions cesarean section delivery rates but does not examine its relationship with the primary outcome (recurrent infections in rare syndromes).
